## Tasks

This project's build, test and lint commands are [yatr](https://github.com/cargopete/yatr) tasks, defined in `yatr.toml`. Run them through yatr rather than calling the tools directly: a task whose inputs have not changed is restored from cache instead of run again.

- `yatr run --agent <task>...` runs tasks and prints one line per task. For a failure it adds the failing command, its exit code and the last lines of its output; the whole output is in `.yatr/logs/<task>.log`.
- Before reporting work as done, run `yatr run --agent ci` and fix what it reports.
- `yatr explain <task>` says whether a task would run or come from cache, and which inputs changed.
- `yatr affected <git-ref>` lists the tasks that changes since a ref can affect.
- `yatr run --json <task>...` and `yatr list --format json` are the machine-readable forms.
- To add or change a task, edit `yatr.toml`, then run `yatr check` and `yatr agents --write`.

| Task | What it does | Runs after | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agents-check` | Fail if the task table in AGENTS.md has drifted from this file |  | cached on its inputs |
| `bench-lint` | Clippy on the bench, which builds a bundled DuckDB |  | cached on its inputs |
| `ci` | Every CI job but demo | `fmt-check`, `fuzz-lock`, `agents-check`, `lint`, `test`, `bench-lint`, `deny`, `ingest`, `ingest-size`, `tab`, `tab-build`, `engine-size` | runs its dependencies only |
| `demo-build` | demo/pkg: burrmill-wasm and its JS glue (needs the pinned wasm-bindgen) |  | cached on its inputs |
| `demo-test` | Every demo/*.mjs against the built engine on a static server | `demo-build` | always runs |
| `deny` | Advisories, licences, duplicates and sources, from deny.toml |  | always runs |
| `engine-size` | The demo's ingest-engine.wasm under 8 MiB gzipped |  | cached on its inputs |
| `fmt` | Format the tree |  | always runs |
| `fmt-check` | Fail if the tree is unformatted |  | cached on its inputs |
| `fuzz` | Fuzz FUZZ_TARGET (csv or sql) from its seeds for SECONDS_PER_TARGET, 600 unless set |  | always runs |
| `fuzz-build` | Build every fuzz target (needs nightly and cargo-fuzz) |  | always runs |
| `fuzz-lock` | fuzz/ has its own lock; fail if it no longer resolves |  | cached on its inputs |
| `generated-folds` | The generated-fold oracle at BURRMILL_CASES cases, 3,000 unless set |  | cached on its inputs |
| `ingest` | Clippy and tests on the tab's reader, bare and with json,parquet |  | cached on its inputs |
| `ingest-size` | The reader's wasm32 graph has no C, and its gzip size |  | cached on its inputs |
| `lint` | Clippy on burrmill, default graph and with datafusion |  | cached on its inputs |
| `tab` | Clippy and tests on burrmill-wasm |  | cached on its inputs |
| `tab-build` | burrmill-wasm for wasm32, warnings refused |  | cached on its inputs |
| `test` | burrmill's tests, default graph and with datafusion |  | cached on its inputs |
